title: Cyrus and the Summer
author: Vesper Ishikawa
blurb: Wren Halloran, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
